literal_AC14: Restart, suspensão e queda de conexão preservam contratos de autoridade, ownership e incerteza, sem repetição produtiva implícita.

asserts: restart returns pending, same Server PID/generation and live Core-owned child
same birth/claim/slot, slot not released while child lives
operation IDs unchanged; physical work marker exactly one
explicit canonical close precedes physical exit and release; no implicit replacement
existing_contract_evidence.limit: Real Windows process test with synthetic native peer; no actual suspension.

asserts: expired or revoked grant still invalid with possible_effect false
operations/receipts unchanged and no old native send/open/probe repeated
valid authority admits only explicitly requested new work, spending one next unit
existing_contract_evidence.limit: Real Server crash/return with injected provider; temporal expiry fixture clearly labeled.

asserts: same live Connector task and executor identity reconnect
connection generation increases; closed old operation remains historical
no extra executor, probe or old physical effect
existing_contract_evidence.limit: Closed prior session, not active-session survival or suspension.

proves_if_observed: actual manual event and same/replaced exact owners
same owned task definitions and logon correlation
honest missing/mismatched shutdown receipt and lost handles
this runner never dispatches productive work or renews authority
does_not_prove: a grant/claim/operation in these empty homes survives suspension
reconciliation of an interrupted productive operation

finite_no_new_paid_call_option.selection: Optional attachment to an already-authorized own Server/Connector session window, before its normal cleanup; not selected or implemented by this proposal.
finite_no_new_paid_call_option.same_runtime_database_required: The observed owner must actually serve B/campaign/nexus-home/nexus.db; do not attach historical rows from another DB to E empty services.

known_terminal_operation.prior_terminal: SUCCEEDED; session and lease CLOSED; same stream watermark76 in retained post-exit proof

before: Fresh canonical GET/qualified mode=ro projection scoped to these exact IDs: operation receipt stage/revision/possible_effect/retry_safe, session/lease/owner generation, binding identity/revision, exact linked grant expiry/used/max and claim/slot status. No content/auth fields.
Capture scoped operation/action/receipt counts and Core stream watermark/turn count; prove baseline before manual suspension rather than assuming historical values remain current.
Capture current Server/Connector cohort and fresh owner generation; write durable record before sleep. No setup, send, resume, issue, renew or native call.
after: On return only same bounded GET/RO projection plus exact owner/task observation; compare terminal operation/lease, no added operation/native turn, no grant extension/reset, no new claim or inferred claim release.
If a field changes legitimately, retain new fact and uncertainty; do not repair/checkpoint-edit or infer replay-safe. No automatic admission regardless of readiness.
finite_no_new_paid_call_option.qualification_limit: This demonstrates non-replay of known terminal history and authority non-renewal across a real suspension, not survival/release of an active native child. Existing T22 evidence covers that distinct ownership/uncertainty contract. Requires a narrow reviewed context binding/manual-event selection; current E plan is not silently changed.
